title: 第7章 全都算对了第8章 报复社会的男人
slug: 算命太准外国客户都哭着喊大佬

第7章全都算对了
赵婶一脸审视的看着林熙，问道：“小姑娘，那符是你自己画的？”
林熙点点头。
“那你也给我画一张呗，让我看看是不是真这么灵！”
林熙看着她精气神十足的脸，摇摇头淡声道。
“你用不着安神符。”
赵婶一愣：“我怎么就用不着安神符了！”
“安神符有安神助眠，压魂稳魄的功效，你入睡快睡眠质量也好，用不着这个。”
更何况观赵婶腕上还戴着一串散发着淡淡金光的手镯，是开过光的，寻常鬼怪邪祟都很难近她身，自然更不需要安神符了。
赵婶一听，倒是没想到林熙知道她睡眠质量好的事情，但想想她的好睡眠可是在一群老伙伴里出了名的，林熙要是提前去打听的话，也不难知道这些事情。
人到老年，觉少觉浅梦多几乎成了常态，赵婶这睡眠质量却丝毫没受年龄影响，她可不得在老伙伴中炫耀一番吗。
安神符林熙不给，赵婶也不气馁，继续道：“那你除了这个安神符还会啥？”
语气里的怀疑已经不加掩饰了。
赵婶也不是说不信这些什么算命画符的，只是她见过的大师可都是白发苍苍，年近古稀，最年轻的也是四十往上的，林熙这种光看岁数就不靠谱，是骗子的可能性太大了。
林熙视线在赵婶脸上顿了顿，忽然道：“还会算命卜卦，你要算吗？”
算命！
算命好啊，当场就可以辨别真假！
“那你给我算算，不算我，算我儿子！”
赵婶在附近也算是有点名气，因为她年轻时候可是省里某个部门的领导，很风光的！
只是老伴死的早，退休后她不想一个人生活，便来到江渝这边和儿子住在一起。

有关她的一些情况早在赵婶来到江渝的这些年被她自己都给抖干净了，倒是她儿子的事情大家不清楚，只知道她有个儿子，长啥样都没人见过，更是不清楚她儿子是做什么的，今年多大了。
因此算她儿子的话，就不存在林熙提前调查情况以此来故弄玄虚的情况了。
赵婶想的很好，却没想到下一秒林熙便朝她伸出手。
“一卦一千。”
赵婶：“？！”
周围人也被林熙说的价格惊呆了。
“一千，她怎么不去抢啊！”
“一千块？天云观的道长也没敢收这么贵吧？”
天云观是江渝市有名的道观，据说观里的天明道长在算命卜卦这方面很有造诣，算出来的都很灵，但算一卦也才五百块。
这小姑娘年纪轻轻的，口气倒是不小，一开口就敢开一千块！
“哎，估计还没成年，不知道骗钱的后果。”
“赶紧把她家长找回来，领回去好好教育一下，再这样下去还得了啊！”
“现在这些小孩真是不学好，一天天书不好好读，竟然还学会坑蒙拐骗了，我要是她家里人真是气都要气死！”
林熙静静听着，没说话。
一卦一千是她仔细思考过的价格，不算低也不算很高，恰好能让大部分普通老百姓也支付得起，也对得起她的实力。
赵婶一听，更是差点惊呼好家伙。

Chapter 7 Everything is correct
Aunt Zhao looked at Lin Xi with a serious look on her face and asked, "Little girl, did you draw that talisman yourself?"
Lin Xi nodded.
"Then you can draw one for me too and let me see if it's really so effective!"
Lin Xi looked at her energetic face, shook her head and said softly.
"You don't need the calming charm."
Aunt Zhao was stunned: "Why don't I need the Calming Talisman!"
"The Calming Talisman has the effect of calming the mind, promoting sleep, calming the soul and stabilizing the soul. If you fall asleep quickly and have good sleep quality, you don't need this."
What's more, Aunt Zhao also wears a bunch of bracelets that exude a faint golden light on her wrist. They are blessed. It is difficult for ordinary ghosts and evil spirits to get close to her, and naturally there is no need for a calming charm.
When Aunt Zhao heard this, she did not expect Lin Xi to know about her good sleep quality, but considering that her good sleep quality was well-known among a group of old friends, it would not be difficult for Lin Xi to know these things if she had inquired in advance.
As people grow older, it is almost normal for them to have less sleep and more sleep. However, Aunt Zhao's sleep quality is not affected by age at all. She can't show off to her old friends.
If Lin Xi didn't give him the God-Calming Talisman, Aunt Zhao was not discouraged and continued: "Then what else can you do besides this God-Calming Talisman?"
The suspicion in his tone was no longer concealed.
Aunt Zhao didn't say that she didn't believe in these fortune-telling talismans, but the masters she had met were all white-haired and nearly 70 years old, and the youngest ones were in their forties. Lin Xi's age alone was unreliable and there was a high possibility that he was a liar.
Lin Xi's eyes paused on Aunt Zhao's face, and suddenly said: "You can also tell fortunes, do you want to tell them?"
Fortune telling!
Fortune telling is great, you can tell the truth from the false on the spot!
"Then you do the math for me, don't count me, count my son!"
Aunt Zhao is somewhat famous in the neighborhood, because when she was young, she was the leader of a certain department in the province, and she was very famous!
It's just that her husband died early. After retirement, she didn't want to live alone, so she came to Jiangyu to live with her son.
Some information about her has been cleared up by Aunt Zhao herself in the years since she came to Jiangyu. However, no one knows about her son. They only know that she has a son. No one has seen what he looks like. It is not clear what her son does and how old he is this year.
Therefore, if her son is included, there is no situation where Lin Xi investigates the situation in advance to create mystery.
Aunt Zhao thought very well, but she didn't expect that Lin Xi would reach out to her the next second.
"One hexagram leads to a thousand."
Aunt Zhao: "?!"
People around were also shocked by the price Lin Xi said.
"One thousand, why doesn't she go and grab it?"
"One thousand yuan? The Taoist priest of Tianyunguan doesn't dare to charge so much, right?"
Tianyun Temple is a famous Taoist temple in Jiangyu City. It is said that Taoist priest Tianming in the temple is very accomplished in fortune-telling and divination. His calculations are very good, but one fortune-telling only costs 500 yuan.
This little girl is young, but her tone is quite serious. She dares to ask for a thousand yuan as soon as she opens her mouth!
"Hey, I guess I'm still young and don't know the consequences of cheating money."
"Hurry up and find her parents, take her back and give her a good education. If she continues like this, it's going to happen!"
"These children nowadays really don't study well. They don't study well every day, and they even learn to deceive and deceive. If I were one of her family members, I would be so angry that I would die!"
Lin Xi listened quietly and said nothing.
One thousand per hexagram was the price she had carefully considered. It was neither too low nor too high, just enough for most ordinary people to afford it and worthy of her strength.
When Aunt Zhao heard this, she almost exclaimed, "What a good guy."
